conservation_status.description: Sinapidendron gymnocalyx is assessed as Near Threatened as it nearly meets the thresholds for criteria B1ab(iii)+2ab(iii). The extent of occurrence (EOO) is less than 5,000 km² and the area of occupancy (AOO) is less than 500 km². There is a continuing decline in the quality of the habitat due to the effect of alien invasive species. Although the number of locations is likely more than ten, development of road infrastructure presents a significant threat which is likely to eventually cause the population to become severely fragmented.
